author: My2ndFavasm
body: So I've done some extensive research on this exact thing, from what I've found and after talking to some people, the best way around your mimic applying curse is to use mimics mischief yourself with your curse immunity and applying a permanent debuff to the enemy, your mimic will not use its own mimics mischief if the enemy has a debuff on them. So def v, res v, att v, mag v, any of those would prevent it from using mimics. I've tested it myself and it does in fact work. Biggest issue is when you find an enemy or raid boss that can't get any of those applied or if they have a self cleanse. (Coming from a beo main)
